_what: Recorded schedules for SignDetLite and Moonshine sharing one PYNQ-Z1 Rocket SoC at 40.000 MHz.  SignDetLite is PERIODIC at 1000 ms with 4 instances; Moonshine is NON-PERIODIC and carries no deadline.  Periodic stripping is on, so every makespan here is Moonshine's own completion, measured around the detector's reserved instances.
_source: b4/schedules/none/T1000 of the recorded co-location run; operator costs are board-measured per dispatch.  Distilled by fpga/pynq-z2/scripts/make_schedule_golden.py.
_deadline_misses: Individual detector DISPATCHES that end after their own instance window closes -- not whole inferences.  One detection is 8 dispatches.
